death.note: Inferred, not stated: no page read for this folder gives a year. saint.gr’s line heads him and Nymphas «Ἄγιοι Νυμφᾶς καὶ Εὔβουλος οἱ Ἀπόστολοι» and the page makes them disciples of the Apostle Paul, who names Euboulos in the second letter to Timothy. The corpus’s own form for a man of the apostolic generation is this century and nothing narrower — fifty-six folders typed `apostle` carry death 1st century, `aquila` among them off his day line’s bare «(I)». The century only.

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Νυμφάς και Εύβουλος οι Απόστολοι», with the rank word and the title left off.
